summary: 1934 Aermotor MC-24 fire tower on Black Mountain in the Gila National Forest; its 1925 observer's cabin is the NRHP-listed piece; actively staffed as of 2020.

corrections.why: The Register and the 2020 report both give a 30-foot tower, which is 9.1 m. The brief's 15.2 m equals 50 feet, the figure from the federal survey station description. The brief's own design field also says 30-foot.
The 2020 report says the 30-foot tower was erected in 1934. No source read says it replaced an earlier tower.
The sources say the original windows were replaced, and the Register says the lookout was remodeled. Nothing read says it was restored.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register and the 2020 report give 30 feet. A 1966 federal survey station description on the Forest Lookouts page says the site has a 50-foot structure supporting the cabin. The story uses 30 feet and reports the survey figure as a disagreement.

The 1934 date is the tower's erection, from the Register and the 2020 report. The 1925 date is the observer's cabin, from the 2020 report. The brief's two build years refer to different structures, so the story gives both.

notes_for_editor: The tower's 1934 date and the 1978 window change are consistent across the Register and the 2020 chapter report. The 1925 cabin and its 1988 listing come from the 2020 report's table and text only; the NRHP nomination itself (NRHP 87002474) was not read, because the cached NPGallery text returned no matching lines. Height is in conflict: 30 feet from two sources, 50 feet from the survey station description, which the Forest Lookouts page dates to 1966 (Coast and Geodetic Survey). The 2020 report gives the erection date as 1938 once, where it and the Register give 1934; the story uses 1934. The brief's 15.2 m is corrected to 9.1 m. The 1977 item is cited only for the staffing fact; the lookout's name is left out. Access and visiting rules are not in any source read, so the access level is restricted with a caution to check with the Ranger District. Leads: the NRHP nomination PDF for 87002474 and the Gila National Forest page for the Black Range lookouts.
